text:
Filip Hronek's name is everywhere this week, and not for anything he did on a given night. Vancouver traded Max Sasson, and as Daniel Wagner of Pass it to Bulis put it, the Canucks "appear to be open for business." Hronek, a right-shot defenseman with term, has been linked to Boston in trade chatter (NHL Trade Rumors, Markerzone), and The Athletic's Mark Lazerus floated him for Chicago.

On the ice, he is carrying a load few defensemen carry: 26:49 a night, 17 points in 26 games, 11 on the power play. That's in line with the 49-point player he was last season. The cost is at 5-on-5, where Vancouver takes only 36% of the expected goals with him on the ice. Some of that is the company he keeps (Evolving-Hockey put his teammates in the bottom 6% last year), and Wagner has argued he's simply playing too much.

He has one goal on 2.02 expected, so a few more should come. The bigger question is which uniform he's wearing when they do.
